context: Deploy workflow pushes a static site to S3 on merge to main. The team is migrating from long-lived IAM keys to OIDC.
explanation: Safe to merge. Adds a concurrency group to prevent parallel deploys from stomping each other, scopes permissions to the minimum needed, and replaces static AWS access keys with OIDC-based role assumption (pinned to a SHA). All three changes are security and reliability improvements with no functional regressions.
